title: SMS Marketing vs. Email Marketing: Pros and Cons for Brands

facts.fact: The article 'SMS Marketing vs. Email Marketing: Pros and Cons for Brands' is dated July 15, 2026, per the page byline.
The article is listed as an 11-minute read.
The article is authored by Christina Scarmeas.

The page defines SMS as standing for 'short messaging service' and describes SMS marketing as including all text messages a brand sends to promote products, engage its audience, and build brand awareness.
facts.quote: SMS stands for “short messaging service,” meaning that SMS marketing includes all text messages your brand sends promoting your products, engaging your audience, and building brand awareness.
